description: This test verifies that a user can successfully authenticate using Okta, ensuring the integration with Okta's identity provider service is functional.
steps: Click on the Okta authentication button.
Verify that the user is redirected to Okta's login page.
Input a valid Okta username in the username field.
Input the correct password in the password field.
Verify that the user is redirected back to https://dev.roost.ai/login with a valid session.
Verify that the user is logged in and redirected to the primary application dashboard.
expected_results: User is redirected to Okta's login page.
User successfully logs in with valid Okta credentials.
User is redirected back to the Roost application dashboard.
A valid user session is created and maintained.
edge_cases: User cancels the login process at Okta's page.
User's Okta account does not have the required permissions.
data_requirements: A valid Okta account with active credentials.
Access to Okta's identity provider service.
Test credentials for an Okta account.
Redirect URI set up correctly in the application.
Session management configured in the application.
dependencies: Okta identity provider service must be operational.
The Roost application must have a valid Okta client ID and secret.
The login page must be accessible.
The OAuth redirect URI must be correctly configured.
performance_metrics: Time taken to redirect to Okta's login page.
Time taken to authenticate and redirect back to the application.
Load time of the login page.
accessibility_requirements: Ensure the Okta login button is accessible via keyboard navigation.
Verify that the button has appropriate ARIA roles and labels.
Ensure the login page is screen-reader friendly.
Verify contrast ratios on the login page meet WCAG standards.
